description: Seed registry for official tax data sources and future imports. This is a planning/import skeleton, not a claim of nationwide runtime completion.

authoritativeSourceOrder: official tax agency rate file, rule file, or API
official assessor, treasurer, municipal, or GIS dataset
official program manual, application guide, or filed form instructions
DSIRE or third-party summaries only as discovery, never as final authority
importPolicy.skipPolicy: If official source data cannot be verified or the tax model kind is unsupported, create an unsupported_tax_model or source_unavailable record with customer-facing value fixed at $0.

sourceFamilies.runtimeGoal: Resolve combined sales/use tax rates and source-backed retrofit taxability when address and taxable basis are known.

recommendedSources.officialOwner: Streamlined Sales Tax Governing Board and member states
recommendedSources.runtimeUsePolicy: Use where member-state files provide rate and boundary joins; validate state-specific file terms before production import.
Prefer official state downloads/APIs over ZIP-only inference. Use lookup-only tools for validation or admin research unless terms permit automated production use.

sourceFamilies.runtimeGoal: Map state tax incentive opportunities to source-backed credit, exemption, deduction, valuation, or unsupported models.

recommendedSources.officialOwner: State legislatures and state tax agencies
recommendedSources.runtimeUsePolicy: Use GPT Pro/Codex research to normalize formulas and required inputs; import only when source URLs and evidence are official.

sourceFamilies.runtimeGoal: Route property-tax incentives to parcel, assessor, tax-bill, and local ordinance inputs without inventing counterfactual property tax values.

recommendedSources.officialOwner: State property tax agencies or equalization boards
recommendedSources.runtimeUsePolicy: Use for statewide exemption/valuation rules and centralized files where production terms are clear.
Use open data for parcel/jurisdiction routing; require uploaded tax bill or licensed source for current bill-line calculations when terms are lookup-only.

sourceFamilies.runtimeGoal: Model credits, rate preferences, and local business taxes when tax-return/accounting inputs exist.

recommendedSources.runtimeUsePolicy: Use source-backed rates/formulas, but keep taxpayer-specific base, deductions, apportionment, and liability as tax-return/accountant inputs.

recommendedSources.officialOwner: City finance departments and municipal codes
recommendedSources.runtimeUsePolicy: Calculate internal-only unless business class and tax base are user/accountant-confirmed.

sourceFamilies.runtimeGoal: Normalize local-option clean-energy, high-performance-building, and economic-development tax incentives where official local adoption can be verified.

recommendedSources.officialOwner: State legislatures and state tax agencies
recommendedSources.runtimeUsePolicy: Use as authority only; do not assume a city/county adopted the option.

recommendedSources.officialOwner: City/county/municipal councils, assessors, and code publishers
recommendedSources.runtimeUsePolicy: Require direct local adoption evidence before enabling a local-option estimate.

sourceFamilies.runtimeGoal: Provide a safe $0 fallback for tax-like opportunities outside current support.

databaseTableSkeleton.purpose: Official source metadata, access terms, refresh cadence, and import status.
Structured sales/use, local tax, and business tax rate records.
Address/geography boundary or tax-code joins for local tax rates.
Normalized credit, exemption, valuation, abatement, deduction, and unsupported tax model records.
Official source URLs and evidence text for every material rate/formula/eligibility claim.
Refresh logs, validation errors, source hashes, and change summaries.

validationRules: Reject tax incentive rules without official source URLs unless explicitly marked unsupported_tax_model or source_unavailable.
Reject user-facing tax estimates without effective dates.
Reject local-option records without direct local adoption evidence.
Reject property-tax savings records that lack either tax bill/counterfactual tax inputs or assessor-confirmed valuation treatment.
Reject business tax rate-preference estimates that lack a tax-return/accounting tax base.
Permit $0 not_applicable_zero_value outcomes when a source-backed eligibility gate is false or qualifying tax base is zero.
